title: The Phantom Vessel
description: What washed up from the Merrow's Kiss pointed the Harbor Captain here - an abandoned lighthouse the charts still mark as active. Whatever's crewing that ship at night is working out of it, and every week it keeps working, Dalhurst loses another boat it needs for the winter catch.

objectives.description: Travel to the abandoned lighthouse on the western coast
Search the lighthouse for the logbook - and whoever kept it last
Put down the drowned dead haunting the lighthouse (0/6)

notes: Continuation of ghost_ship_rumors - not chained via prerequisites/next_quest, which is out of scope to change per hard limits; noted here so a later pass can wire it. Threat: Dalhurst loses a boat a week to whatever's crewing the phantom ship. The cursed_anchor (find_source target) is stated plainly in the description as the cause.
